name: Breese (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Breese (a red unicorn and the letter B on white).
history: Municipal flag of Breese; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Breese arms — red unicorn and letter B
